name: Being Loyal
overview: Scripture reveals that loyalty is closely tied to faithfulness and obedience to God above all else, as shown when Peter and the apostles assert the necessity of obeying God rather than men (Acts 5:29). Loyalty also involves being trustworthy and dependable, exemplified by the faithful servant entrusted with provision (Matthew 24:45) and the friend who sticks closer than a brother (Proverbs 18:24). The peace that accompanies such steadfastness is a divine safeguard for the heart and mind through Christ (Philippians 4:7), while God’s hatred of certain behaviors (Proverbs 6:16) underscores the seriousness of true loyalty in the believer’s life.
